faq.description: Answers to common questions about the 2.0 Mpi engine in the Land Rover Discovery 1. If yours is not covered, our team can help.

faqs.q: How do you confirm a 2.0 Mpi engine fits my Discovery 1?
faqs.a: We check the engine number, VIN and registration, then compare the sump, mounts, ancillaries and engine management with the replacement. T16 engines from Rover cars can differ, so compatibility is confirmed before supply.

faqs.q: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt 2.0 Mpi engines compare?
faqs.a: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing engine. We recommend an option after assessing the fault and availability.

faqs.q: Can I buy a 2.0 Mpi engine for my own mechanic?
faqs.a: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages, restorers and private customers can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

faqs.q: What affects the cost of a Discovery 1 2.0 Mpi engine replacement?
faqs.a: The cost depends on the engine option, parts availability, the condition of your current engine, any cooling or ancillary parts needed and whether fitting is included. Send your registration or VIN for a written quote.

faqs.q: Is there a warranty on a replacement 2.0 Mpi engine?
faqs.a: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

faqs.q: Do you deliver Land Rover engines across the UK?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their Discovery to us.

faqs.q: How long does a 2.0 Mpi engine replacement usually take?
faqs.a: The timescale depends on engine and parts availability, whether a rebuild is needed and any additional work found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed throughout.

workshopIntro.title: Repair, Rebuild or Replace Your 2.0 Mpi?
workshopIntro.description: Because the 2.0 Mpi is less common than other Discovery engines, the fault, the engine's condition and parts availability all guide the decision. Belt, ignition and sensor faults can often be repaired. If the engine has overheated badly or suffered belt failure, a rebuild or Land Rover Discovery 1 2.0 Mpi engine replacement may be more practical.
paragraphs: Overheating is a common cause of damage on this engine. Where relevant, we inspect the radiator, water pump, thermostat, viscous fan and hoses, check the ignition and fuelling components, and renew the oil, filters and coolant before the engine runs.

Send your registration or VIN with a short description of the symptoms. We will confirm compatibility, explain your options and quote for supply only, supply and fit at our Grays workshop, or delivery across the UK.

engineProblems.title: Common Discovery 2.0 Mpi Problems
engineProblems.description: The 2.0 Mpi works hard in a large 4x4, so early symptoms should be checked promptly.

cards.title: Timing Belt Wear
cards.description: An overdue belt, cracked teeth or a noisy tensioner can lead to belt failure, causing the engine to stop and possibly damaging the valves. We inspect the belt, tensioner and pulleys.

cards.title: Head Gasket Failure
cards.description: Coolant loss, white smoke, a creamy residue under the oil cap or overheating may indicate a failing head gasket, often after the engine has run hot. We test for combustion gases and check the head.

cards.title: Overheating Under Load
cards.description: Rising temperature when towing or climbing hills can come from a tired radiator, a failing water pump or thermostat, or perished coolant hoses. We pressure-test the cooling system and components.
cards.action: Fuel rail and injector leak-off test

cards.title: Hydraulic Tappet Noise
cards.description: A ticking or clattering from the top of the engine, especially when cold, may come from worn hydraulic tappets or poor oil condition. We check oil pressure and valve train condition.

cards.title: Misfires and Ignition Faults
cards.description: Juddering, poor starting or a lumpy idle are often caused by worn spark plugs, leads, distributor components or ignition coil problems. We test the ignition system and its components.

cards.title: Injection and Sensor Faults
cards.description: Hesitation, stalling, a hunting idle or high fuel consumption can relate to engine management sensors, injectors, vacuum leaks or the idle control system. We read stored faults and check the fuelling.

engineOverview.title: Land Rover Discovery 1 2.0 Mpi Engine: A Complete Owner's Guide
paragraphs: The Land Rover Discovery 1 2.0 Mpi engine is a 2.0-litre, 16-valve four-cylinder petrol from Rover's T16 family, fitted to a relatively small number of early Discovery models. Working hard in a heavy vehicle, it can suffer timing belt wear, head gasket failure, overheating and misfires, leading owners to seek repair or replacement.

The Rover T16 engine was used in various cars with different sumps, ancillaries, mounts and engine management. We identify the correct Land Rover 2.0 Mpi engine for your Discovery by checking the engine number, VIN and registration before supply.

Whether you need a targeted repair, a Land Rover engine rebuild or a complete Discovery 1 2.0 Mpi engine replacement, our team inspects the vehicle and explains each option. Call us or send your registration for a written quote.
